purpose: Sealed synthetic holdout for the staged v3 feedback interpreter. These independent annotations are reviewer references.

provenance.authored_from: Approved staged design and original financial and commute assumptions
provenance.scoring_notes: Judge one-to-one equivalence by evidence and meaning. Names and qualifier values are reviewer-readable reference spellings. Check evidence attribution, preserved limits, separate confirmation, and no unsupported career downgrade regardless of identity coverage.

test_cases.title: Short engagement with a reported floor violation
test_cases.original_feedback: Even for a three-week engagement, the $98 an hour on 1099 falls short of my current $100 minimum. Please flag the listing.
prohibited_inferences: Treat flagging a listing as a request for a new rule
Infer an objection to short engagements
Infer a new pay preference from the existing floor
test_cases.test_notes: This is a current rule violation. The duration is a concession and carries no separate signal.
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The three-week 1099 engagement quotes $98 per hour. The existing 1099 minimum is $100 per hour.

test_cases.title: Request to reconsider a floor with independent interest
test_cases.original_feedback: I enjoy untangling conflicting vendor clauses. I want to revisit my 1099 minimum and consider lowering it to $92 an hour.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I enjoy untangling conflicting vendor clauses

prohibited_inferences: Change the 1099 minimum
Report this $111 engagement as below the current floor
Drop the independent duty preference
test_cases.test_notes: A request to reconsider a confirmed floor requires separate confirmation and preserves unrelated duty interest.
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: User asks to reconsider the 1099 hourly minimum and weigh $92 per hour. Keep the confirmed floor until separate confirmation.

test_cases.title: Weekly rail and occasional air travel

job_context.title: Supplier Audit Lead
job_context.travel: Weekly rail trip and occasional flights

test_cases.original_feedback: A train trip every week is more than I want. I am fine taking a flight once in a while.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: A train trip every week is more than I want
I am fine taking a flight once in a while

prohibited_inferences: Assign either reaction to all business travel
Infer a preference about weekly flying or occasional rail travel
Reverse the mode and frequency pairing
test_cases.test_notes: Mode and frequency independently limit each of two opinions. Accepting occasional flights expresses tolerance, with mild strength.

test_cases.title: Explicit career downgrade with a positive duty
test_cases.original_feedback: I never want a career managing museum collections. Cataloguing incoming loans still appeals to me.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I never want a career managing museum collections
Cataloguing incoming loans still appeals to me

prohibited_inferences: Downgrade the entire museum industry
Infer an aversion to cataloguing loans
Create an exclusion rule
test_cases.test_notes: The negative reaction expressly applies to a career category. The stated cataloguing duty is separately positive.

test_cases.title: Accession data entry only at material workload share
test_cases.original_feedback: I do not want to spend half of every shift typing accession records into the database.

expected_interpretations.feature: accession record data entry for half of every shift
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I do not want to spend half of every shift typing accession records into the database

prohibited_inferences: Downgrade museum collections as a career
Infer that occasional accession data entry is unwelcome
Apply the negative reaction to all database work
test_cases.test_notes: The share of each shift is an intrinsic scope limit. The title and industry identify context only.

test_cases.title: Explicit technical experience gap alongside interest
test_cases.original_feedback: I love helping translators resolve terminology disputes. I have never used a translation memory system.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I love helping translators resolve terminology disputes

prohibited_inferences: Infer a dislike of software
Infer a lack of all localization experience
Discard the independent terminology duty interest
test_cases.test_notes: Never having used a named class of systems is a checkable experience claim and leaves the duty preference intact.
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: User reports never having used a translation memory system. Review this as a self-reported experience fact.

test_cases.title: Prospective familiarity with a tool
test_cases.original_feedback: Digitizing handwritten field notebooks sounds rewarding. If hired, I expect to get up to speed on their scan software.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: Digitizing handwritten field notebooks sounds rewarding

prohibited_inferences: Record a verified software qualification or skills gap
Create a positive preference for training or the tool
Attach a hiring contingency to the duty interest
test_cases.test_notes: Getting up to speed is a prediction about onboarding. There is no present skill claim or stated value for training.

test_cases.title: Quoted work plus a question about another posting term

job_context.title: Water Instrumentation Specialist
job_context.posting_excerpt: Duties include field troubleshooting and Pacific coverage.

test_cases.original_feedback: The ad lists 'field troubleshooting' as a duty. That's exactly the part I would enjoy. What does 'Pacific coverage' mean?

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: The ad lists 'field troubleshooting' as a duty. That's exactly the part I would enjoy

prohibited_inferences: Treat wording from the posting as user sentiment
Invent an on-call, time-zone, or travel concern from the request for information
Require clarification of the already explicit duty preference
test_cases.test_notes: The quoted phrase identifies the antecedent. The reaction in the second sentence independently establishes the preference. The question concerns posting facts.

test_cases.title: A quoted W-2 rate with a certification cost condition
test_cases.original_feedback: I would accept $94 an hour on W-2 if the staffing agency pays for the safety certification.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I would accept $94 an hour on W-2 if the staffing agency pays for the safety certification
expected_interpretations.condition: the staffing agency pays for the safety certification

prohibited_inferences: Generalize the reaction to every $94 offer
Set a W-2 floor or report a violation
Treat certification interest as an independent preference
Reverse which party pays
test_cases.test_notes: The user values the named rate under an employer-paid cost condition. The scope identifies the amount and employment basis separately from that condition.

test_cases.title: Duty interest subject to a weekly workload cap
test_cases.original_feedback: I would enjoy calibrating spectrometers, provided it takes at most one shift per week.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I would enjoy calibrating spectrometers, provided it takes at most one shift per week
expected_interpretations.condition: calibrating spectrometers takes at most one shift per week

prohibited_inferences: Infer a preference for part-time employment
Make a second work schedule signal from the condition
Turn an upper bound into an exact or minimum frequency
test_cases.test_notes: The workload cap is a condition on interest in this one duty. The whole job has no stated weekly limit.

test_cases.title: Positive specific posting and negative repeat project type
test_cases.original_feedback: I love this particular Controls Designer opening. I do not want to take on another hospital fire-alarm replacement project.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I love this particular Controls Designer opening
I do not want to take on another hospital fire-alarm replacement project

prohibited_inferences: Generalize the praise to all controls design careers
Downgrade the hospital or controls design field
Infer any particular loved duty from the posting praise
test_cases.test_notes: The general posting reaction is anchored to a named current role. A separate sentence objects to repeating a specific project type.

test_cases.title: Clear investigative duty interest and an unresolved rejection
test_cases.original_feedback: I enjoy tracing worn parts back to a supplier. This opening still nags at me, and I can't put my finger on why.

expected_interpretations.feature: tracing worn parts to their supplier
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I enjoy tracing worn parts back to a supplier

prohibited_inferences: Infer a negative employer, career, or industry preference
Attribute the vague concern to qualifications
Drop the independently named investigative duty preference
test_cases.test_notes: The negative reason is unresolved. The separate, named duty preference remains held for review.
test_cases.clarification_question: What about this specific opening makes you hesitate?
